review_comments.body: **Old reads refill cleared cache** If a client reads and writes concurrently, a read already in flight can undo this purge. `Retrieve` and `ListSecrets` call `cache.Add` after their GET returns. A GET can capture the old value, finish after the write calls `Purge`, and put the old response back. Later reads then return stale secrets until expiry. Coordinate read-side cache insertion with invalidation so reads started before a write cannot refill the cleared cache. Add a test that holds a GET open while a write completes.

**Cache tests miss promised behavior** The new test only reads through `Retrieve`, and its server returns success for every write. It never checks `ListSecrets` invalidation or the stated behavior that failed writes preserve cached entries. Changes that break either behavior can still pass. Add a list-read case and a failed-write case that verifies the next read still comes from cache. Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
